Nightwood

Nightwood

Hold the fire. Outlast the night.

Chop, mine and light your first fire by day, then wall in your camp. At night, something very large comes out of the forest.

Profiles

Three separate games, each with its own save. Play one, or start it over.

Play together

One player hosts their world and gets a room code. Friends type the code to join (up to 4 players).

Display

Keys click one, then press the new key

Gamepad: left stick moves, right stick aims · A use · B roll · X strike · RB heavy · LB block · Y crafting · D-pad ↑ build, ↓ eat, ← → tools · L3 whistle · R3 turn the view · LT fire · RT water · Menu pauses. Building: X place, RB next, LB turn, RT remove, B cancel. Menus: D-pad moves, A picks, LB/RB tabs, B back.
